mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly inflation rate below 2% signals monetary policy accommodation, reducing risk premiums and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 9.5% triggers a shift to risk-on assets as investors anticipate labor market tightening, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not exceed baseline by 1% or more when UNRATE crosses the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates below 1.5% and rising unemployment benefits signal dovish monetary policy, amplifying equity risk-adjusted returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.5% and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp in the next month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day returns fail to outperform baseline by 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in economic demand (GDPC1) during a late-cycle expansion signals peak utilization, prompting investors to buy undervalued stocks and driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 decline does not correlate with positive 60-day returns, or regime conditions are misclassified.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent below-trend demand growth (HOUST < 600) indicates weakening economic momentum, prompting risk-on asset flows and positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline by 1% when HOUST remains below 600.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 signals robust supply-side growth, reducing corporate profit expectations and pressuring equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not fall below baseline by 1% when INDPRO crosses above 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) and rising demand growth (GDPC1 increase > 5%) create a dual accommodative environment, amplifying equity valuation growth and positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and GDPC1 increases > 5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to outperform baseline by 2% when both proxies meet the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in business investment demand (RSAFS) during a monetary tightening cycle signals contractionary policy effects, dampening corporate earnings growth and leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS decline does not correlate with negative 60-day returns, or regime conditions are misclassified.
